subject: prd/argus-boundary-enforcement
statement: When the docgate gate runs, the structure arm shall report a named defect when any tier bundle contains a token that is not a defined action-class token (so a never-class act cannot be granted by any data state).
rationale: DINV-5 no grant of a never-class act — structural (J2)
fit_criterion: on the seeded fixture (a bundle listing an undefined / never-class token), the arm reports a defect naming the token; the pinned legal vocabulary passes; the check verifies token-membership, not a separate "no-never-grant" scan (matching the template checklist)
